Generated Narrative: CodeSystem retina-conclusion-code-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://dips.no/fhir/RetinaIntegration/CodeSystem/retina-conclusion-code-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinitionx
1001 KI-gradering (basert på nåværende bilder)This examination is waiting to be graded by the AI system.EY12
1002 Primærgradering (basert på nåværende bilder)This examinations is waiting to be graded by a primary grader.EY11
1003 Sekundærgradering (basert på nåværende bilder)This examination is waiting to be graded by a secondary grader.EY01
1004 Ny fotokontroll (primærgradering)Patient should be scheduled for a new routine eye examination graded by primary grader or AI.EY02
1005 Ny fotokontroll (sekundærgradering)Patient should be scheduled for a new routine eye examination but graded by secondary grader.EY04
1006 Oppfølging i programmet settes på ventParticipation in the screening program is put on hold.EY24
1007 Oppfølging i programmet avsluttesPatient is discharged from the screening program.EY25

description: Codes for the current or final conclusion of the grading process (1000-series).
